title: Universal torsion classification for quartic self-fibers
objective: Classify the rational torsion of P=(-2p,2q) on V^2=U^3+2pU^2+4q^2 for every rational quartic parameter.

title: Generic degree-5 normalization and base-field locus
objective: Prove the generic three-node quartic and normalization conic, then classify when that conic has a point over Q and over the branch quadratic field.

title: Generic degree-5 complementary j formula
objective: Parametrize the normalization conic over the branch field and interpolate a certified two-parameter formula for the complementary elliptic j-invariant.

title: Exact database of primitive covers
objective: Store source curves, both elliptic factors, primitive maps, fields, ramification, arithmetic invariants, and exact certificates for degrees 3 through 11.

title: Arithmetic of complementary factors over number fields
objective: Compute ranks, torsion, conductors, isogeny classes, local data, and descent information for systematic number-field families.

title: Automated source-to-CAS discrepancy detection
objective: Extract displayed formulas from TeX, normalize them, and compare them automatically with generated CAS identities.

title: Degree-independent self-fiber and normalization engine
objective: Turn the symmetric self-fiber construction into a reusable engine with component selection, normalization, genus, and certificate output for arbitrary input degree.

title: Primitive degree-7 benchmark and map recovery
objective: Recover and certify both primitive degree-7 maps for Kumar's rational family, including exact target identities, differential pullbacks, pole divisors, and independent Magma degree computations.

title: Kumar family importer for degrees 6 through 11
objective: Encode Kumar's tautological genus-2 families and the two elliptic j-invariants on Y_-(n^2) for every n from 6 through 11.

title: Eigenform-guided exact map recovery
objective: Recover rational maps from split differentials using formal integration at finite or infinite target points, linear rational reconstruction, modular solving, coefficient lifting, and final function-field verification.

title: Galois-closure complement algorithm
objective: Implement Gallese's non-diagonal fiber-product quotient for arbitrary degree and certify subgroup, genus, quotient, and complement data.

title: Finite-field, CRT, and interpolation backend
objective: Avoid coefficient explosion by solving at good primes and parameter specializations, then lifting with CRT and certifying the reconstructed characteristic-zero formulas.

title: Exact nonprimitive high-degree composition engine
objective: Generate and certify degree n*m^2 covers by composing a primitive degree-n map with multiplication-by-m on the elliptic target.

title: Frey-Kani anti-isometry synthesis
objective: Construct new split Jacobians from anti-isometries E[n] to E'[n], reconstruct genus-2 curves, and recover the two primitive degree-n maps.
